# Evidence sources

Prefer, in order:

1. Current-head repository code and tests.
2. Current-head GitHub check/workflow results and logs.
3. Immutable artifact, plan, compiled output, or scan tied to the current head and target.
4. Repository policy/ruleset and configuration.
5. Read-only MCP evidence from GitHub or product documentation/state tools within their actual scope.
6. Current official vendor documentation for version-specific semantics.
7. Clearly labeled inference when direct evidence is unavailable.

MCP source availability is not itself proof. GitHub code review may omit tools that are not annotated read-only.
